results.description:
Caring for Mom or Dad shouldn't mean chaos in the family group chat.

Caregiver is a family care coordination app for adult children and siblings caring for an aging parent. Each loved one gets one care hub with a shared calendar, medication tracker, tasks, care logs, vitals, document vault, and live updates, so everyone in the care circle stays aligned without endless texts.

Whether you're coordinating care at home, in assisted living, or from a distance, Caregiver helps families manage senior care in one shared place. Care is shared, visible, and organized so nothing gets missed. Families stay aligned, reduce stress, and spend less time tracking updates - and more time supporting the people they love.

SHARED MEDICATION TRACKER
Log doses, set reminders, and reduce "Did Dad take his meds?" anxiety. Everyone in the family sees what matters in one shared log.

SHARED CAREGIVER CALENDAR & APPOINTMENTS
Put doctor visits, therapies, and appointments in one shared calendar so siblings, helpers, and primary caregivers stay aligned—even across cities.

SHARED TASKS, CARE CHECKLISTS & DUE DATES
Turn vague worries into a shared task list: errands, follow-up items, home safety tasks, and care plan steps with notes and due dates everyone can act on together.

SHARED CARE LOGS, VITALS & HEALTH TRENDS
Log blood pressure, pulse, blood sugar, temperature, mood, and daily notes in one place. Bring clearer context to appointments and spot patterns over time.

SHARED DOCUMENT VAULT FOR ELDERLY PARENT RECORDS
Keep insurance cards, IDs, medication lists, and visit notes in one secure place, so the right file is there in stressful moments.

SHARED FAMILY UPDATES WITHOUT THE UPDATE TEXTS
See recent activity across medications, tasks, appointments, care logs, and documents. Fewer repeated questions; clearer accountability for everyone helping Mom or Dad.

FREE TO START
Essentials for care coordination are available without blocking the basics behind a paywall: calendar, tasks, medications, and care log notes. Free is your care hub as admin. Inviting family to edit with you is Premium — often with a short intro trial when Apple still offers one. Subscriptions (paid by the care hub admin) also add more loved one profiles, expanded document storage, health trend charts, and longer care log history. Invited family benefit on hubs they share.

PRIVACY & TRUST
Your family's information matters. We're supported by optional Premium subscriptions—not banner ads. Published by Calming Aura Studios LLC. Review our Privacy Policy in the app or on our website.

LEGAL
Terms of Use (EULA): https://calm-aura.github.io/tos_and_privacy/caregiver/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy: https://calm-aura.github.io/tos_and_privacy/caregiver/privacy-policy.html

Caregiver supports care coordination; it does not replace professional medical advice. Always follow your health professional's guidance.

results.description:
Caring Village is the all-in-one app for family caregivers. Coordinate medications, schedules, tasks, and documents — and keep your whole care circle in the loop — without the chaos of texts, spreadsheets, and missed calls. Whether you're managing an aging parent's care from across the country or coordinating with siblings across town, Caring Village keeps everyone on the same page.

Why Caring Village?

Caregiving is rarely one person's job — but it often ends up that way. Multiple schedules, medications to track, documents to find, decisions to make together. Caring Village brings it all into one secure, family-focused platform so you can spend less time managing logistics and more time being present.

Key Features:

Julia – Your AI Caregiving Assistant
Meet Julia, your AI-powered caregiving assistant. Available anytime, Julia answers questions, offers guidance, and helps families make more informed decisions throughout the caregiving journey.

Advanced Medication Management
Set detailed medication reminders, track adherence, and share updates with your care circle. No more wondering if a dose was taken.

Shared Care Calendar
Keep everyone aligned with a shared calendar that syncs with external calendars so appointments don't slip through the cracks.

Printable Care Calendar
Export and print calendars for offline use or to share with doctors and family members.

Task Lists
Create and assign tasks to care circle members. Family members can volunteer for responsibilities — so caregiving is shared, not shouldered alone.

Expert-Curated Checklists
Access checklists built by caregiving experts to guide you through complex situations, from daily routines to emergency planning.

Customizable Care Plans
Design care plans tailored to your loved one's specific needs, with flexible reminders to stay on track.

Wellness Journal
Track moods, symptoms, and milestones. Share photos and updates with your care circle, where family members can like, comment, and stay emotionally connected — even from a distance.

Secure Document Storage
Store and organize medical records, insurance forms, and legal documents in one secure hub. Everything in one place when you need it most.

Built for Families Who Share the Load

Caregiving doesn't have to fall on one person. Caring Village makes it easy for your whole family to step in — volunteer for tasks, track medications, read updates — so the load is shared and nothing gets missed. Whether your family lives under one roof or across time zones, you'll have the tools to stay aligned, divide responsibilities, and show up for each other.

Who Is Caring Village For?


Family caregivers supporting aging parents
Spouses and partners managing chronic conditions
Families coordinating care across multiple households
Anyone who wants to get organized and share the caregiving load


Over 85,000 families use Caring Village to coordinate care and keep everyone in it.

Download today and see what organized caregiving looks like.

results.description:
Somehow you became the one who keeps track of it all — the pills, the appointments, who said they'd stop by. When a parent is getting older, a partner is in treatment, or someone you love needs care every day, it almost always lands on one person: you.

CircleCare shares the load. Create one care circle around the person you care for, invite the people who help, and everyone works from the same up-to-date picture, whether they live down the street or across the country.

EVERYONE ON THE SAME PAGE
- Medications, appointments, tasks and notes in one shared place
- See who did what: who gave a dose, who finished a task, who left a note
- The activity feed shows every update from everyone in the circle, so nobody has to ask "did anyone check?"
- With reminders on, if a dose isn't marked in time, the alert goes to the person taking it, then to the carers, then to the whole circle

MEDICATIONS, SHARED
- Daily, weekly or custom schedules, with reminders
- Mark a dose taken or skipped, and the whole circle sees it
- New: as-needed medications. Log a dose when it's given, like a painkiller, and everyone can see when the last one was given and by whom

APPOINTMENTS AND TASKS
- One shared calendar for doctor visits, treatments and tests
- Assign tasks and appointments to someone, or leave them open for whoever can help
- Add notes and questions so the next person knows what happened

NEW: THE DAILY UPDATE
Each evening at 7pm, the Home screen shows a short summary of what the circle logged that day. If something was logged, you get one quiet notification, with no health details in it. It's free, and you can turn it off.

HEALTH INFO WHEN IT MATTERS
Allergies, conditions, doctors, insurance and emergency contacts in one place, ready to share as text or a PDF. Keep documents like test results and insurance details with the circle too.

FREE TO START, FAIR AS YOUR TEAM GROWS
Free: 1 care circle for you + 1 carer. The person you care for can join too and doesn't count towards that. Medications and reminders are free forever. No credit card needed.

Premium, for families with more helping hands:
- Unlimited family members: everyone who helps, in one circle
- Add by voice: say a medication, task or appointment and we fill in the form for you to check. On supported phones.
- Adherence reports to share with doctors, plus calendar import
- 1 GB of documents per circle
- AI care assistant
- Up to 5 care circles

Monthly or yearly, priced fairly for your country. Yearly includes a free trial. Only the person who creates the circle pays. Invited family members never pay.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
This is your family's health information, not ad data. No ads. We never sell your data. Only the people you invite can see your circle.

IN 8 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, French (Canada), German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Portuguese (Portugal). Everyone chooses their own.

GET STARTED IN A FEW MINUTES
Create a care circle, add a medication or an appointment, and invite your family. Nobody should have to carry this alone.

Terms of Use: https://circlecare.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://circlecare.app/privacy/

results.description:
Tuktu is a community-powered care provider that matches family members and seniors who need support to safe, local, friendly companions for everyday needs. Our smart matchmaking connects you with best-fit companions – just like family – with the advantage of lower cost and flexible terms. 


WHY CHOOSE TUKTU? 
• Safety – All Tuktu helpers undergo a thorough background check, including a criminal record check, reference checks, and empathy-based training. 
• Affordability – Our Tuktu helpers are members of the community, not full-time caregivers. You are billed for a minimum of 1 hour, and after the first hour in 15 minutes increments. 
• Flexibility – There are no contracts or fixed terms, you can book services on-demand when you need them. You can book a service from 24 hours in advance up to 2 weeks in advance. 
• Support – We are reachable between 9:00 AM and 8:00 PM by phone and email for any questions about our services or issue with a booking. 


OUR SERVICES 
• Companions – Quality time and great conversation. Book an engaging Tuktu for hobby activities, as company for a walk, or just for spending time together. 
• Helpers at home – A variety of household services to help aging at home. Book a friendly Tuktu for housekeeping, tech help, shopping, gardening and more. 
• Travel Assistants– Accompaniment by car, public transport or walking. Book a reliable Tuktu for medical appointments, shopping trips, visiting friends and more. 

… and specialized and seasonal services such as Virtual assistants and Snow removal. 


HOW IT WORKS 
1. Download our app, sign up with your phone number, and create a profile for either yourself or a loved one with our onboarding. 
2. Select which service you want, who you are booking for, where and when you want the service, and find your perfect Tuktu with the help of our smart matchmaking. 
3. If needed, we will call you for additional info before service time. You can also chat with your Tuktu inside the app if you need to sort out details or ask questions. 
4. Your Tuktu will arrive to provide top-quality service! They will log the start and end time of the service for billing purposes. 
6. Pay easily online with your credit card via Stripe. We also offer payment via cheque with an invoice.  
5. Rate and review your Tuktu to let us know how they did! 


Visit www.tuktu.ca to learn more about us.

results.description:
CareCircle is a family carer app and care organiser for people caring for ageing parents, elderly relatives, partners or loved ones. Keep medications, care notes, tasks, appointments, daily care logs and handovers in one shared place, so everyone involved knows what happened and what still needs doing.

CARE FOR AGEING PARENTS TOGETHER
Family care is easier when everyone works from the same information. Create a private care circle, invite relatives or paid carers, and coordinate care without scattered messages, paper notes or repeated phone calls.

SHARED CARE ORGANISER
• Add family members and carers to one care circle
• Use administrator, caregiver and viewer roles
• Keep care tasks, appointments and schedules together
• Leave clear handovers between visits or shifts
• Let relatives who live farther away stay informed

MEDICATION TRACKER AND REMINDERS
Keep medication schedules, reminders and dose history together. Record who gave a dose and when, so the next carer can see the latest record.

DAILY CARE LOG AND NOTES
Record care notes, symptoms and observed vitals such as blood pressure, temperature and weight. Build a clear daily care log the family can review without searching through chats or notebooks.

TASKS, APPOINTMENTS AND CARER SCHEDULE
Use the shared calendar for care tasks and appointments. A shared schedule and task list help family members divide responsibilities and see what still needs attention.

HANDOVERS AND SHARED CARE
Create a clear handover when another person is taking over. Shared care notes make the transition easier and reduce the need to reconstruct the day from messages.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION IN ONE PLACE
• Documents such as letters, discharge summaries and care plans
• Emergency profile and important contacts
• Care-team contacts and supplies
• Printable PDF reports

BUILT FOR REAL DAYS
• Works offline and syncs when a connection returns
• Medication reminders
• Large-text and high-contrast options
• Face ID / Touch ID lock
• English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Polish and Portuguese

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free includes one person being cared for, two caregivers, unlimited medications and care records, and retained history.

Premium supports up to 10 care recipients and 25 caregivers, more care-team contacts, larger document storage, temporary share links and advanced reports. A 7-day free trial is available.

CareCircle is an organisational record-keeping tool, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or provide medical advice, and it cannot contact emergency services. In an emergency, contact your local emergency service.

SUBSCRIPTION
CareCircle Premium is an auto-renewable subscription with a 7-day free trial.
Monthly: USD 7.99 per month. Annual: USD 59.99 per year. Prices may vary by region.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
